nodes.label: Reduced-motion graceful degradation
nodes.rationale: Motion must preserve intent under prefers-reduced-motion (shorten/simplify/crossfade) rather than disabling all motion, so meaning is not conveyed by motion alone.

nodes.label: LCP asset + font preload strategy
nodes.rationale: Preloading the true LCP asset and first hero font, plus deferring choreography JS, targets FCP/LCP on first visit without blocking the parser.

nodes.label: GSAP local-copy detection for ScrollSmoother compatibility
nodes.rationale: The preloader checks whether GSAP is already available locally/vendored before the main GSAP + plugin bundle loads at the end of the page, so it can cooperate with ScrollSmoother if present instead of double-loading or conflicting.
nodes.norm_label: gsap local-copy detection for scrollsmoother compatibility

nodes.label: Progressive enhancement (no-JS fallback) pattern
nodes.rationale: ContactForm and Lightbox both accept that without JavaScript the trigger/form renders but does not activate — an accepted tradeoff rather than server-rendered fallback behavior.

nodes.label: aix: namespace retirement
nodes.rationale: The aix: object was declared retired in CLAUDE.md but was still recommended by the old ia/frontmatter.md schema and read by no tool; its one real field, role:, was prose migrated into description, where it belonged.

nodes.label: SessionManager generalization for session-gated motion
nodes.rationale: Generalizing SessionManager's state shape from a single heroIntroPlayed boolean to a per-section played map lets every AbstractSection reuse the same end-state-jump channel that reduced motion already uses, avoiding duplicate mechanisms and a last-write-wins clobbering race if sections each constructed their own SessionManager instance.

nodes.label: Scrub exception for session-gated motion
nodes.rationale: Forcing _applyPostIntroState() on a scrubbed section would fight its scroll-driven playhead the same way the existing reduced-motion restart-jitter guard already avoids, so the session-gating bypass must live in AbstractSection where trigger config is visible, not in resolveSectionMotionProfile.

nodes.label: Choreography atomic layering — historical generation brief
nodes.norm_label: choreography atomic layering — historical generation brief

nodes.label: two-gel backing composition with full-page scroll track
nodes.rationale: top/left/width/height are layout properties set only at init and on ScrollTrigger.refresh(); y (transform) is the only property animated per scroll frame, to avoid layout thrash during scrub.
nodes.norm_label: two-gel backing composition with full-page scroll track

nodes.label: time-based reveal not scroll-driven
nodes.rationale: Bio's reveal fires once off the landing chain; the base class's scroll-driven replay would restart the animation mid-scroll, so _onEnter/_onEnterBack emit events but don't call playIntro.

nodes.label: bio-outro-pin four-beat outro ScrollTrigger
nodes.rationale: Separate from BIO_TRIGGER because flipping scrub there would hand it the intro timeline and its end:'bottom bottom' would pin the full section, not a short exit beat. Currently inert because the active split variant supplies no buildOutro.

nodes.label: serial landing chain (header→video→bio)
nodes.rationale: The header opens the landing then leaves — its hero exit is the page's first statement; the video reveal answers it; Bio follows and closes the chain. Every link is an AnimationBus event, never a direct call, so LandingSequence never reaches into an organism's internals beyond public play* methods.

nodes.label: contact form security notes (write token, sanitization)
nodes.norm_label: contact form security notes (write token, sanitization)

nodes.label: Two-Gel Backing Intro/Outro Sequence
nodes.rationale: Composed via injected gelManager rather than the viewport-normalized GEL_ARRANGEMENTS schema alone, because that schema cannot express section-relative geometry, rotation, or scroll-locked tracking; follows the Hero precedent of injecting a gelManager into section animations.

nodes.label: Breakpoint Motion Profile Schema (base/sm/md/lg/xl/reduced)
nodes.rationale: Centralizes motion policy so design/engineering stay aligned and sections/cards don't risk policy drift; replaces a narrow binary motion/static toggle with breakpoint-aware timeline+trigger channels.

nodes.label: Card Dealt-In/Flicked-Out Curved Path Motion (fish-swimming-upriver metaphor)
nodes.norm_label: card dealt-in/flicked-out curved path motion (fish-swimming-upriver metaphor)

nodes.label: Choreographer Deterministic Decision Rubric (GSAP vs Tailwind scoring)
nodes.rationale: GSAP starts with a +2 DX bias and wins ties, because GSAP generally provides better DX for complex, reusable choreography while Tailwind reduces JS overhead for simple 2-state transitions.
nodes.norm_label: choreographer deterministic decision rubric (gsap vs tailwind scoring)

nodes.label: Home Header Hero-to-Menu Timed Transition Spec
nodes.norm_label: home header hero-to-menu timed transition spec

nodes.label: Time-Driven Hero-to-Menu Transition (superseded 2026-08-28)
nodes.rationale: Time is the sole trigger (not scroll/tap) to avoid the interaction gate, missing forward cue, and unexpected scroll reactions of the prior ScrollTrigger+isActive swap; the menu role itself was later removed on 2026-08-28 but the trigger model and CSS/GSAP seam discipline survive as governing HomeHeaderManager.

nodes.label: Motion Accessibility Hard Rules (R1-R5)
nodes.rationale: Reduce vestibular triggers and keep motion optional for comprehension while preserving rapid-iteration DX and deterministic, auditable Choreographer decisions.

nodes.label: Default Reduced-Motion Strategy Mapping (disable/simplify/keep by patternType x priority)
nodes.norm_label: default reduced-motion strategy mapping (disable/simplify/keep by patterntype x priority)

nodes.label: GEL_ARRANGEMENTS Viewport-Normalized Schema (rect + mask)
nodes.rationale: Viewport-normalized rect+mask schema chosen for portable, swappable arrangements; MVP applies changes immediately (no tweening) so reduced-motion compliance is automatically satisfied.

nodes.label: Hero Outro Gel Composition (bg-gel-0 scroll-scrubbed throw-offstage)
nodes.rationale: HeroAnimations accepts an injected gel manager so hero and gel share one synchronized GSAP timeline; scroll-scrubbed via HeroTriggers so no imperative timeline restart is required on hero:exit.
nodes.norm_label: hero outro gel composition (bg-gel-0 scroll-scrubbed throw-offstage)

nodes.label: UI-Components Index-and-Dwell Looping Sequence (Process organism variant)
nodes.rationale: Registered as a buildIntro factory variant (ui-components-loop) rather than a new sections/ folder or bespoke init() API, because the existing Process organism's PROCESS_VARIANT_FACTORIES contract only exposes buildIntro/buildOutro hooks.
nodes.norm_label: ui-components index-and-dwell looping sequence (process organism variant)

nodes.label: Sticky Local In-Page Nav with Scrollspy
nodes.rationale: Below lg the in-view current link itself is the disclosure control (no separate toggle button) to avoid a redundant control, trading a native <button> for role="button" on an <a>.
nodes.norm_label: sticky local in-page nav with scrollspy

nodes.label: Frontmatter Governing Rule ("carries only what path/filename/extension cannot")
nodes.rationale: A field that restates location is noise at rest: it costs tokens on every read and drifts the moment a file moves.
nodes.norm_label: frontmatter governing rule ("carries only what path/filename/extension cannot")

nodes.label: Retired Frontmatter Keys (id, atomicLevel, template*, aix:, backlinks, owner, perf, role, docType, ...)
nodes.rationale: Removed because each value is constant, derivable from the file's own path, or (for role/docType) migrated into description/type rather than deleted since it held the only hand-written prose.
nodes.norm_label: retired frontmatter keys (id, atomiclevel, template*, aix:, backlinks, owner, perf, role, doctype, ...)

nodes.label: Home Page as Standalone Document (not extends base.njk)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate fork so the home page owns its critical path for LCP control and preloader/choreography gating, which a shared base layout would obscure.
nodes.norm_label: home page as standalone document (not extends base.njk)

nodes.label: Home Page Known Drift & Risks (unsupplied copy, stale skipLinks, placeholder metaDescription, dead import)
nodes.norm_label: home page known drift & risks (unsupplied copy, stale skiplinks, placeholder metadescription, dead import)

nodes.label: CSS Import Cascade Order (typography→Tailwind→base→tokens→decorations→plugins)
nodes.rationale: Ensures design tokens are available when utility classes are generated and prevents cascade conflicts; v4 emits utilities once from @import "tailwindcss", so no @tailwind utilities directive is added in partials.

nodes.label: Typography Critical Loading Order (imports.css → Tailwind → fontFamilies.css)
nodes.rationale: Font imports must load before Tailwind CSS compilation, otherwise generated font-family utilities reference fonts that don't exist and fall back unexpectedly.
nodes.norm_label: typography critical loading order (imports.css → tailwind → fontfamilies.css)
